# Samwell.ai

> Samwell.ai is an AI-powered academic writing platform that helps students generate essays, research papers, and literature reviews with built-in citation management and plagiarism detection.

Samwell.ai provides comprehensive AI writing tools for academic work, supporting multiple citation formats (MLA 9th, APA 7th) and offering features like essay enhancement, outline generation, and plagiarism checking. The platform also includes an affiliate program for creators seeking passive income opportunities.

## Core Writing Tools

- [AI Essay Writer](https://www.samwell.ai/ai-essay-writer): AI essay writer tool supporting MLA 9th format without plagiarism
- [Research Paper Generator](https://www.samwell.ai/research-paper-generator): A-level research paper generator with AI assistance and citation management
- [Essay Outline Generator](https://www.samwell.ai/essay-outline-generator): Free essay outline generator tool with MLA 9th citation support
- [AI Writing Assistant](https://www.samwell.ai/ai-writing-assistant): AI writing assistant for academic essays and research with MLA citations
- [Literature Review Tool](https://www.samwell.ai/academic-literature-review): Academic literature review tool with APA 7th citations and references
- [Essay Enhancement](https://www.samwell.ai/upload-essay): Essay enhancement tool with citations, plagiarism checking, MLA support
- [AI Writing](https://www.samwell.ai/ai-writing): AI writing assistant for essays, research papers with citation generation
